title: Chad Zarif
description: Chad ensures our family law client’s needs are understood and met and all of the firm’s efforts are centered around this focus.
html:
Chad has a Bachelor of Commerce in Marketing and spent the first 20 years of his career working for large multinational businesses like Nestle, in various commercial roles.

Chad was instrumental in the inception of Nolan Lawyers in April 2016 and initially worked behind the scenes until he joined the firm full time in March 2018.

Chad now leads the day to day operation of the firm with his strong leadership skills including client management, staff management, communication systems and initiatives.

Chad is most passionate about our clients and their experience with the firm. Chad ensures our client’s needs are understood and met and all of the firm’s efforts are centred around this focus.
